summary: Turn a declared beginner layer sequence into inspectable goal predicates, legal move demonstrations, learner commits, hints and exact step-level undo rather than an irreversible animation playlist.
objective: A learner can identify the current subgoal, preview why a legal sequence preserves earlier work, attempt it, undo or retry, and resume from the exact committed state.
intent_signals: teach a layer method step by step
undo one tutorial step without restarting
show which solved pieces an algorithm preserves
example_prompts: Build a cube tutorial from daisy through final-layer edges with steppable previews, learner turns and reversible checkpoints.
not_for: Claiming the method is fastest, optimal or best for every learner.
Competition coaching, motor-skill assessment or an exhaustive algorithm database.

entities.name: Goal predicate
entities.guidance: Compute the current lesson goal and preserved-piece set from canonical cube state, not from clip time or a screenshot.

entities.name: Move workspace
entities.guidance: Show notation, affected layer, preview endpoint and changed/preserved pieces before a demonstration commits.

entities.name: Checkpoint ledger
entities.guidance: Store the exact state, lesson step, learner history and hint level at each semantic checkpoint.

state_contract.model: A standard 3×3 exact piece-state engine plus a versioned lesson plan. Each step declares prerequisite predicate, target predicate, permitted setup, demonstration sequence, preserved predicate, hint ladder and completion rule.
state_contract.authority: The cube engine determines legality and goal completion. The tutorial controller owns prompts, hint level and checkpoints; animation never advances a lesson by itself.
actions: Request a conceptual hint, affected-piece preview or exact next-move hint.
Preview, step, commit or cancel a demonstration; learner turns use the same legal engine.
Undo one move or restore the prior semantic checkpoint; reset returns to the declared lesson start. Checkpoint restore is one controller transaction over cube state and lesson metadata.
state_contract.initialization: Accept the guide's declared start or a validated reachable 3×3 state that satisfies the selected step prerequisite; otherwise explain which prerequisite is absent.

invariants: Every displayed move is legal and uses the declared notation frame.
Completing a step means its state predicate is true; finishing a clip or consuming a move list is insufficient.
A demonstration followed by its reversed inverse moves restores exact cube state; it does not by itself restore hint level, focus or other controller metadata.
Step restore transactionally returns cube state, history, hint level, focus, camera target and highlighted pieces to the checkpoint.
Earlier-layer preservation is checked after each committed demonstration where the lesson declares it.
motion_guidance: In Blender, author readable cubie shells, face patterns and optional exploded layer markers; do not bake instructional state into mesh names alone.
Three.js owns goal highlighting, move arrows, move queue, checkpoint transactions and accessible text controls.
Pause between moves and let reduced motion jump to exact endpoints while keeping notation and changed-piece explanation visible.

object_craft.structure: Individual beveled cubies with distinct face tiles, narrow gaps and stable piece IDs.
object_craft.material: Satin face colors paired with symbols or labels; selected and preserved sets use boundary/pattern cues.
object_craft.articulation: One temporary layer pivot presents a move; exact state rebuild follows commit.

object_craft.structure: A companion panel or in-world board with current goal, notation tokens, hint depth and checkpoint control.
object_craft.material: High-contrast text and non-color status icons readable at the tutorial camera.
object_craft.articulation: Updates from lesson state and remains operable without direct dragging.

physical_contract.scope: Exact legal cube state with guided presentation; no mechanism physics or timing-performance assessment.
checks: Goal and preserved predicates match exact state.
Undo and checkpoint restore are exact and reversible.

creative_affordances: Use ghost pieces, cycle arrows, exploded layers, narrated text or a small-multiple before/after view according to the learner.
Allow alternate legal sequences when they declare the same target and preserved predicates.
known_limits: The cited official page supplies one staged guide sequence, not a proof of teaching effectiveness, completeness or optimality.
No learner study, tutorial interaction, cube engine or algorithm was run.

claims.statement: The official Rubik’s 3×3 solution-guide page presents an ordered beginner sequence covering a daisy, white cross, white corners, middle layer, then yellow-cross and final-layer corner and edge stages.
claims.scope: The live official guide structure read 2026-09-08; this claim does not assert optimality, completeness for arbitrary methods or measured learning benefit.
